answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, with slashing if its attestations prove false. Creating many fake identities then means crossing a costly ridge: every clone must fund its own deposit, so scale no longer comes free. An ivory-tower reputation score alone is not enough, because a single operator could farm many clean histories; stake makes each history expensive to abandon. Honest agents keep their deposit and earn fees, while a garden of cheap sock puppets withers once slashing removes their capital faster than they can replant it.
